author_time: separate sensitivity comparison; no author fallback in current integrated main results
missing_committer: retain commit_time_missing where a temporal comparison is needed
historical_reproduction: stage3_run.py preserves the former baseline's legacy committer-or-author mode; current run_stage3_replay.py explicitly selects committer
cargo_ranges: comma-intersected semver comparators; bare numeric implies caret; unsupported syntax remains insufficient
snapshot_assumption: Applicable observed public registry records represent satisfying releases at commit time, absent concrete contrary evidence; unobserved deletions, migrations and omissions may violate this assumption.
scope: Public-registry dependency references in the episode population recorded by each run summary.
population_note: source_episode_population and baseline_queryable describe the original frozen baseline. Rebuilt runs record their own episode population and queryable denominator in summary.json.
